engineNote: Generation runs through the connected Higgsfield MCP, NOT the public Higgsfield REST API. The MCP's actual parameter surface differs from the public docs — values below are EMPIRICALLY TESTED on this MCP (2026-05-17), not derived from docs. The legacy Runway @tag / 3-reference-cap and Kling CFG/MICRO-MOVE rules are not inherited.

image.keyframeModelNote: DECISION (2026-05-17, empirically tested): nano_banana_2 (Google Nano Banana Pro) is the BellaCiao keyframe/identity engine. It executes the literal prompt verbatim, holds the single reference-image identity, respects the soft-closed-lip-half-smile lock, and produces clean backgrounds (no signage/neon/text). It is the tested path for every start/end keyframe.
image.resolutionNote: nano_banana_2 at 2k returns ~1536x2752 vertical; downscale/crop to 1080x1920 on export.

identityLock.mechanism: single reference image via medias[{role:'image', value:<media_id|jobId|https url>}]
identityLock.note: One reference per character. Reference = the character's canonical Drive _reference.png, downloaded from Drive and uploaded via media_upload -> PUT -> media_confirm, then passed as the single medias image. Drive file IDs are NOT directly usable as MCP media — they must be uploaded first. Multi-character scenes: compose sequentially or use a combined reference (enzo_maria, arun_priya).

engineFindings.soul_2_untrained: REJECTED for locked characters. soul_2 WITHOUT a trained soul_id force-enables a prompt-enhancer that cannot be disabled (API returns 'enhance_prompt ... does not support this parameter' and sets it true even when omitted). The enhancer paraphrases the prompt and reintroduces every forbidden failure mode (wide toothy grin, model symmetry, airbrushed skin, neon signage with text) and discards identity locks. Verified on Bella jobs 933ff0f1 / 868d73f5 / 78ae16a8.
engineFindings.soul_2_with_soul_id: VIABLE SECONDARY (verified 2026-05-17, job 7f570a35 with soul_id eeb60f04-...). A trained Soul flips behaviour: resolved params show enhance_prompt:false, the literal prompt is preserved (no paraphrase), identity is strong and reusable across shots, the soft closed-lip half-smile lock is respected, skin is acceptably natural, and the full Soul param surface is exposed (seed, style_strength, custom_reference_id). CAVEAT: inline background negatives partially LEAK — the test still produced a red neon sign and a street-through-window despite explicit 'NO neon / NO signage / NO exterior' in the prompt. Use for cross-shot identity continuity, but reinforce background framing and prefer nano_banana_2 when the strict no-signage/no-exterior rule is critical.
engineFindings.nano_banana_2: PRIMARY keyframe engine. Literal prompt preserved, identity held from single reference, all locks respected INCLUDING clean backgrounds (inline negatives obeyed — no signage/neon/text/exterior leakage). Default for every start/end keyframe.
engineFindings.publicRestApiParams: The scaffolded width_and_height enum / custom_reference_strength / style_strength / enhance_prompt:false from the public REST docs are NOT exposed by this MCP and are intentionally dropped here.

image.negativesNote: No negative-prompt field on either model via this MCP. The Shared Negatives and Bella-specific negatives in characters/shared.md MUST be folded into the prompt body as a trailing 'ABSOLUTELY NO ...' clause. nano_banana_2 fully honours inline negatives (incl. background); trained soul_2+soul_id honours identity/expression negatives but leaks some background negatives (neon/exterior); untrained soul_2's enhancer ignores them entirely.

video.status: UNTESTED — video runs through the MCP generate_video tool, not the public dop REST API. Parameters below are from public docs and MUST be re-verified against the MCP (models_explore + a gated test) before first use. No video call is permitted until a content item is storyboard_approved (see approvalGate).
video.api: dop / Cinema Studio (image-to-video) — public-doc reference only
video.modelNote: dop-preview default for storyboard-approved renders; dop-turbo for fast internal previews; dop-lite for cheapest drafts.
video.endFrameNote: Cinema Studio supports a start frame plus an OPTIONAL end frame. Per content item we produce start.png + end.png keyframes; both are passed so motion is bounded between approved frames.
video.motionStrengthNote: Higgsfield motion_strength (0-1, API default 0.8) replaces the legacy Kling CFG/MICRO-MOVE motion guidance. 0.55 = controlled documentary handheld feel.
video.ciaoMotionNote: Replaces the old 'CFG 0.3 for Ciao stillness' rule — low motion_strength keeps the Italian Greyhound still and identity-stable.

klingToHiggsfieldMapping.note: Reconciled to the tested MCP surface (2026-05-17). custom_reference_strength / style_strength / soul_style_id / enhance_prompt are NOT exposed by this MCP and were removed from the active config.
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Runway @tag face-crop reference: Single reference image via generate_image medias[{role:'image'}]; no @tag, no multi-ref. Trained Soul soul_id is the per-character identity handle once verified.
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Runway 3-reference cap: N/A — one reference image per generation; multi-character handled sequentially / combined refs.
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Kling CFG (prompt/identity adherence): Not a tunable on this MCP. Identity is carried by the reference image + literal prompt on nano_banana_2 (soul_2's mandatory enhancer makes it unusable for locked characters).
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Kling CFG 0.3 for Ciao stillness: Maps to video motion control (untested — see video.status).
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Kling MICRO-MOVE: Maps to video motion control (untested — see video.status).
klingToHiggsfieldMapping.Negative prompt block: No native field — inline 'ABSOLUTELY NO ...' clause in the prompt body (honoured by nano_banana_2).

approvalGate.rule: Per content item: generate script + scene prompts + still keyframe(s) (start.png/end.png). The user manually approves the storyboard. Video generation (any dop/Cinema Studio call) is BLOCKED until the content item's status is 'storyboard_approved'. Nothing spends video-generation budget without explicit manual approval.

frameConventions.restaurantNameRule: Restaurant name NEVER appears in the visual. Strip genre words (trattoria, restaurant, Italian, osteria, and the specific restaurant name) from image prompts; carry restaurant identity in the script/VO only.
frameConventions.antiExteriorClause: ABSOLUTELY NO exterior view, NO street, NO sky, NO shop-fronts, NO painted signage, NO neon, NO restaurant name on any wall.
